svg.title: What a student owes when repayment starts
svg.desc: A bar: $30,000 borrowed, $7,500 a year for four years in unsubsidized loans at 6.52%, plus about $5,900 of interest built up during school and the six-month grace period, so the first bill is figured on about $35,900.
svg.text: What you owe when repayment starts
$7,500 a year for four years, unsubsidized, at 6.52%
built up before the first payment
First bill is figured on about $35,900
